rows.en: I'm worried about Daisaku, aren't you?

What kind of thing is that? We can't beat it by attacking head-on!

Concentrate fire on the monster robot! We have to stop it here, whatever it takes.
Ms. Kitakura! Please leave the Gigants to us.
Ms. Kitakura! Leave the Gigants to us, 'kay?
Thank you! I'm counting on you.

…!?

Giant Robo!

Daisaku, are you all right?
Everyone… I'm sorry I made you worry!

Nngh… Giant Robo! It survived!?

Go! GR-2!!
Branch Chief! We've found the BF's headquarters!
Hmph! U7, you're so mean. Making me worry that much…

Sorry, sorry… The Unicorn special bulletproof vest saved my life!

Besides… to fool your enemies, you have to fool your friends first, right? Don't be mad, don't be mad…
Hmph, I don't care anymore!!

This is finally the last decisive battle!

The BF may throw every monster we've ever beaten at us! U7, we can't let our guard down!
It's the BF's all-out attack! Don't lose, Robo!!
Heh heh heh… Foolish Earthlings! Today is your final day.

…!?

Emperor Guillotine!?

Robo! Take out Emperor Guillotine!
Robo! What's wrong? Robo?

Heh heh heh… You've fallen right into my plan!

After all the battles so far, Giant Robo doesn't have a single drop of atomic energy left.
What…? Robo's energy?

What's more… you can't lay a hand on me!

My body is a mass of atomic energy!

If my body explodes, the Earth will be blown to smithereens.
That's crazy!?
You don't believe me? Hmph, then look at this!

…!?

The mountain's gone!
Did you see that!? That was only a tiny piece of my body.
This is… If we attack Emperor Guillotine, the Earth really might disappear.

Giant Robo can't do anything anymore!

People of Earth! From this moment on, I, Emperor Guillotine, shall become the ruler of this Earth.
It's no good… We can't do a thing!

Oh, that's right! Robo was equipped with auxiliary energy, just in case!

Go! Robo!!

What!? Auxiliary energy?

Fool! Go ahead, make Robo fight me! The Earth will be blown away along with Robo!
U7! Stop Robo!
Robo, stop! The Earth is in danger!!
Uoh… Wh-what are you doing!?
Robo! Listen to me! Robo, where are you going?
Where is it taking Emperor Guillotine?

Robo! Come back! Robo!!

Robo, you dummy! Come back!! You'll die!
Robo…
Robo! Why won't you obey my orders! Robo, come back!
Robo…
Branch Chief… that light just now?
That was the end of Emperor Guillotine! And…
Giant Robooo!!
Robo… sacrificed itself to save the Earth.
Robo! Giant Robooo!!
Emperor Guillotine and the BF were destroyed! And… Giant Robo vanished from before the people's eyes.
But even so… when danger visits this Earth again, perhaps our Giant Robo will come flying from out of nowhere.
Goodbye, Giant Robo! Farewell!
Robooo…!!
Defeat the Space Vampire Dracula and all Kelbaans!
Defeat the monster robot GR-2 and all Gigants!
Defeat Giant Arm Ganger, Electric Current Monster Sparky, and all Gigants and Kelbaans!
Defeat Emperor Guillotine!
Daisaku Kusama or Giant Robo is defeated

Dan, your brother is nearly complete!

Just a little more… once we get some magnelium energy, our Seven will finally start moving!

Even the Ultra Garrison couldn't ask for a better opponent than Seven… Hah hah hah!
Ugh… S-stop it!
All right, once more… aim for that beam lamp!
Yes, sir…

…!?

All right! A direct hit!
Ah… Seven… Seven moved!
We did it! We did it!!
Captain…!
Yes… Everyone, you did well! Now the Earth will be saved!
Maybe we can rescue Dan and Soga too.

How ironic that the Ultra Garrison's final opponent is Seven…

We have no more use for this base! Set the time bomb!

Heh heh heh… This will be your grave! Hah hah hah!

"Damn it…

Wait, calm down! Think carefully… about what to do at a time like this!"
It seems… we've done something terrible.
We gave energy to a fake Ultraseven.
Damn it… What have we done! That Alien Guts…
What? What is it?
It appears an explosion occurred at the bottom of Lake Kawaguchi…
Ah…!?
Ultraseven…
This time it's the real one! Alien Guts, take that!!

Dan… you mustn't get up!

You're lucky, you know that? You were found collapsed near Aokigahara!

If they'd found you a little later, you might not have made it…
Ugh…
No, no… Listen to me for once! You're terribly exhausted…
I'm fine…

You're not! The people most confident in their bodies are the ones who don't know their own weaknesses…

Now, lie still…

"My body won't move the way I want… Has everything gone wrong?

Pulse 360… blood pressure 400, and a fever of nearly 90 degrees. What's the cause?

Did Alien Guts do something to me? No… that can't be!

Then these abnormal symptoms… could it be!?"

This Alien Guts incident was probably… no exaggeration to call it the greatest invasion in history!

Ultraseven was safe, but Soga's whereabouts are still unknown!

The enemy's lake-bottom base destroyed itself, but we haven't completely sealed off Alien Guts's forces!

And the eerily quiet space fortress is also a threat we can't take lightly!

Tighten radar surveillance, step up patrols, and strengthen our defense posture even further so the invaders can't do as they please with the Earth any longer!
Roger!

uncertain: U14983/U14984: キタクラさん rendered 'Ms. Kitakura' (Kitakura is established female by her speech); 任せてちょ rendered 'Leave it to us, 'kay?'.
U15022: Giant Robo referred to as 'itself'.
U15029: 独ロボット read as 怪ロボット ('monster robot').
U15030: 巨腕ガンガー / 電流怪獣スパーキィ titles rendered 'Giant Arm Ganger' / 'Electric Current Monster Sparky' (only base names in glossary).
U15033: マグネリウムエネルギー rendered 'magnelium energy'.
U15058: Dan's vital signs (pulse 360, BP 400, fever ~90 degrees) kept as in source.
